The young founders explain how their new company will change the way people work. Our product helps small teams ship software faster and with fewer mistakes. We started last year and already have thousands of happy customers. The market is large and growing quickly every single month. Our team has built similar systems at large companies before. We are raising money to hire engineers and grow our sales team. Customers tell us they save hours every week using our tool. Next year we plan to expand into three new countries in europe.
